meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 激活高强度工作模式,让 AI 助手在会话中遵循你的全部规则。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你使用 Codex 编程,并希望 AI 严格按你的规则执行。
copy.tagline_en: Turn on power mode to make the AI follow all your rules for the rest of the task.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Codex and want your AI to strictly follow your working guidelines.

howto.what: 当你说出“ultrawork”或“ulw”时,Claude 会先显示“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”,然后按该模式规则工作:先调查代码、划分任务轻重、定下成功标准,用记事本持续记录、逐步测试留证据,直到全部通过。
howto.when: 当你的话里出现“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发;之后整段任务都按该模式执行。

howto.what_en: When you say “ultrawork” or “ulw”, Claude displays “ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!” and then follows the mode's rules: surveys code, triages the task, sets success criteria, keeps a notepad log, tests step by step, and captures evidence until all criteria pass.
howto.when_en: Triggered when your prompt contains “ultrawork” or “ulw”; the mode then applies for the rest of the task.

say_en.text: Fix the login page bug in ultrawork mode.
say_en.note: It prints the enable line, then fixes with evidence.
